meta.title: Competitor 360 — Master Data (consolidated schema v2)
meta.scope: B2C only (B2B parked per Jai, Meeting 2)
design_notes: Component rows are FIXED (see component_registry) and render for every zone; dash where not applicable.
Cell value is dynamic: cost = max(0, selectedQty - free_allowance) * unit_fee. Shows 'Included' when present but charge is 0; dash when not applicable.
Itemised zones (Meydan, IFZA) build cost from per-component fees. Bundled zones (RAKEZ, Ajman) carry the cost in the tier price; component rows mostly 'Included'.
max_visas on a package powers the gray-out: if selected visas > max_visas, that package column greys out.
Every leaf has confidence + source. value:null = to be filled. Do NOT treat assumed cells as final.
meta.how_to_fill: Replace null values and update confidence to 'confirmed' when real figures land. See open_questions at the bottom for exactly what is missing and who owns it.
change_tracking: A value that has moved carries a marker; the grid highlights that cell and offers a small info mark reading 'Updated {date} · was {from}'. A leaf with NO marker is unchanged — the default state of everything here.

Two ways to mark, one index. (a) INLINE, beside the existing confidence/source: "y1": { "fee": 6000, "confidence": "confirmed", "changed": { "on": "2026-07-15", "from": 6010 } }. from = the prior value, or null if the value is newly added. (b) changelog entry — the only way to mark a FLAT number (RAKEZ/Ajman tier_price maps have no object to hang a marker on).

Path grammar (package_id, never an array index): components.<key>.<y1|y2>.fee · packages.<package_id>.tier_price.<N>y · packages.<package_id>.tier_price_new · packages.<package_id>.tier_price_renewal · promo.packages.<package_id>.price_now
changes_seen_before clears the board: any marker dated on or before it renders normally (no highlight, no info mark). Bump this one date to reset the grid — never edit the individual markers.
changelog is the permanent audit trail, newest first. It keeps every change on record even after the highlight is cleared.

confidence_legend.confirmed: Official source (price list / factsheet) or directly confirmed.
confidence_legend.assumed: Estimate / placeholder — overwrite when real data lands.
confidence_legend.missing: No data yet — value is null.
confidence_legend.na: Not applicable for this zone (renders as dash).

_offers_note: MARKETING OFFERS — deliberately separate from pricing. An offer is NOT a price: nothing here feeds the cost engine, and no figure below changes any all-in. The grid stays the costed truth; this list is 'what is everyone advertising right now'.

Each entry: zone · active · headline (the crux, one line) · detail (one short line) · date (when we confirmed it) · source · image (null, or a path to an ad/Instagram screenshot when the submission channel exists).

Where an offer quotes a figure that also lives in the schema (DSBH promo prices, Ajman installment), the selfcheck asserts the two agree — static offer text quoting live data is exactly how a file starts contradicting itself.
A zone with no entry renders as an honest gap ('no offer tracked yet'), not a silent omission. v1 is hand-maintained: when an offer changes, edit this list.
